name: Guoba Certified
noteEs: Creator multi-game del ecosistema HoYoverse (Genshin + HSR principalmente, ocasional Neverness to Everness). Mezcla guides accionables, viewer summons en vivo, y Q&A. Su content es accesible para audiencia general — no es theorycraft denso, es introducción a personajes con casos de uso prácticos. Para players que vienen de Genshin y entran a HSR, Guoba sirve de puente.
noteEn: Multi-game creator in the HoYoverse ecosystem (mainly Genshin + HSR, occasional Neverness to Everness). Mixes actionable guides, live viewer summons, and Q&A. His content is accessible for general audiences — not dense theorycraft, more like character intros with practical use cases. For Genshin players entering HSR, Guoba is a useful bridge.
highlightsEs: Live streams con viewer summons y Q&A
Buen puente para Genshin players nuevos en HSR
